verdict.rationale: The Calendar API documents a first-party bulk-deletion operation that clears all events on an account's primary calendar, which covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows retention controls. missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-expiry policies, account- or org-level data deletion and retention settings, documentation of how long deleted data is kept, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: This operation deletes all events associated with the primary calendar of an account.
